studies.name: BRUIN CLL-313
studies.cancer: Previously untreated chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma
studies.molecularEligibility: No known chromosome 17p deletion; del(17p) excluded
studies.biomarker: del(17p) negative or not known to be present (eligibility exclusion)
studies.geography: Multinational randomized trial; site-level locations not independently reconciled
studies.status: Active, not recruiting (secondary registry snapshot; not an Oct 2026 transition)
studies.finding: FDA approved pirtobrutinib for previously untreated CLL/SLL without known 17p deletion. Randomized n=282. Median PFS not estimable vs 33.5 months; HR 0.20 (95% CI 0.11-0.37), p<0.0001. Overall survival immature.
studies.limitations: FDA approval is an indication-level regulatory event, not a new trial status transition.

studies.name: DESTINY-Lung04
studies.cancer: Advanced/metastatic nonsquamous non-small cell lung carcinoma
studies.molecularEligibility: Activating ERBB2/HER2 exon 19 or exon 20 mutation
studies.status: Active, not recruiting (registry-derived; status transition not confirmed)
studies.finding: n=454; median PFS 14.3 vs 8.3 months (HR 0.63); response 70.0% vs 44.5%. In T-DXd arm 20.8% ILD/pneumonitis, including 4 fatal grade 5 events (1.8%). First-line indication investigational; OS interpretation immature.
studies.limitations: Preserve fatal pulmonary toxicity and do not infer first-line approval or proven overall-survival advantage.

studies.name: REZILIENT3
studies.cancer: Untreated locally advanced/metastatic nonsquamous non-small cell lung carcinoma
interventions: Zipalertinib 100 mg twice daily plus platinum chemotherapy
studies.status: Active, not recruiting (secondary registry snapshot; unconfirmed transition)
studies.finding: 279 randomized after six-person safety lead-in. Median PFS 14.5 vs 8.5 months; HR 0.50 (95% CI 0.34-0.73), p=0.00015. ORR 65% vs 40.3%. Grade>=3 adverse events 87.1% vs 54.4%; OS immature.
studies.limitations: Data are interim sponsor-reported. Zipalertinib investigational, no regulatory approval claimed.

studies.name: CERVINO
studies.molecularEligibility: Prior exposure to PI, IMiD and anti-CD38; no genomically mandated mutation stated
studies.biomarker: BCMA (therapeutic target; not a mandatory tumor-genetic eligibility mutation)
studies.finding: n=393 in interim data; ORR 74.0% vs 45.7%; PFS HR 0.40 (95% CI 0.29-0.54), p<0.0001. OS prespecified efficacy boundary not crossed. Etentamig unapproved and investigational.
studies.limitations: Do not treat nominal OS p-value as success against prespecified statistical boundary.

studies.name: IMPACT MET

studies.finding: Phase 1, target enrollment 12. Not yet recruiting -> Recruiting on Oct 16; UF Health recruiting. Eligibility and interventions revised. Tissue CD70 IHC >=5% eligibility. No clinical outcomes posted.
studies.limitations: Source is a registry-history mirror; direct ClinicalTrials.gov history version not independently verified.
